edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.

onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner in transferOwnership.
setCM is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
setCM writes the CM interface address.
setTotalSupply is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setTotalSupply writes the totalSupply variable.
initialize is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
ownerOf reads the local _ownerOf mapping for initialized ids.
ownerOf proxies to CM.ownerOf for uninitialized ids <= 3259.
CM interface instance is used inside ownerOf.
balanceOf branches on the _balanceOfInitialized flag.
balanceOf returns the local _balanceOf value when initialized.
balanceOf proxies to CM.balanceOf for uninitialized addresses.
CM interface instance is used inside balanceOf.
_mint calls ownerOf to require the token does not already exist.
_mint writes _ownerOf[tokenId_] = to_.
_mint branches on _balanceOfInitialized[to_].
_mint increments or re-initializes _balanceOf[to_] allowing balance arithmetic drift.
_mint increments totalSupply, the counter also used as the next tokenId.
_mint calls CM.balanceOf when rebalancing an uninitialized balance.
_transfer requires from_ == ownerOf(tokenId_).
_transfer clears the outstanding getApproved entry.
_transfer updates _ownerOf[tokenId_] to the receiver.

_transfer branches on _balanceOfInitialized for both addresses.
_transfer calls CM.balanceOf to rebalance uninitialized accounts.

_approve writes getApproved[tokenId_].

approve delegates to the internal _approve.

_isApprovedOrOwner reads isApprovedForAll[_owner][spender_].

approve reads ownerOf(tokenId_) for authorization.
approve reads isApprovedForAll[_owner][msg.sender].
